metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent started from a blocked premier.ticketek.com.au page, typed https://www.ticketek.com.au/help in the address bar, passed Cloudflare verification, and successfully reached the Ticketek help center at help.ticketek.com.au/hc/en-us. Agent then navigated into ticket delivery articles but scrolled excessively after step 10.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can type URLs in Chrome address bar, handle Cloudflare verification pages, and navigate to specific help center URLs.
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent successfully reached the help center (step 6) and the delivery article (steps 7-9), but failed to stop at the correct URL. The failure point (step 10) is scroll-based, not navigation-based. The help center navigation itself was reliable.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplifies the original task to just the first successful intermediate subgoal: reaching the Ticketek help center. The agent demonstrated reliable capability to navigate from premier.ticketek.com.au to help.ticketek.com.au/hc/en-us in the reliable prefix before deviation.
